Security forces kill six militants, two soldiers martyred in Dera Ismail Khan

News Desk

Security forces killed six militants during an intelligence-based operation in Dera Ismail Khan district, while two soldiers were martyred in an exchange of fire, the military said on Thursday.

According to the ISPR, the operation was conducted on the reported presence of militants and weapons and ammunition were recovered from those killed.

A sanitisation operation was being carried out to eliminate any other militants found in the area, the statement added.
